async def act(page):
    """
    From the Manage Products listing, click the top-left "Add Product . . ." button to begin adding a new product.
    This action is expected to navigate to the product creation flow, so it is the last action performed here.
    """
    # Wait until the Manage Products heading/area is present to ensure page is ready
    await page.wait_for_selector('text=Manage Products')

    # Click the Add Product button using the full get_by_role path through the table -> row -> cell -> button
    await page.get_by_role("table").get_by_role("row", name="Manage Products Add Product . . .").get_by_role("cell", name="Add Product . . .").get_by_role("button", name="Add Product . . .").click()
